review_snapshot.rule: This disposition is valid only while the Current node-shard manifest retains the same canonical row digest. A Source change reopens compact review rather than silently inheriting this approval.

review_rule: Use Chengfeng as the continuous mainline and source authority for first-round content. Use Suyi only as compact cross-check/framework evidence. Admit a Suyi delta only when it supplies a stable high-value identity, boundary, role or discrimination structure missing or under-specified in Current. Do not create a second learner course.

chengfeng_review.boundary: Some child OCR rows remain source_bound_ocr_needs_review. The Ethics closure admits only readable, stable source relations needed by the repaired learner semantics. Local OCR noise in unused child wording does not manufacture whole-subject Source debt; any claim whose exact wording is not recoverable remains source-primary/deferred rather than guessed.
reviewed_high_value_areas: C01 individual-society relation and dialectical life-conflict/error-life-view structure
C02 ideal/belief traits and ideal-reality relation
C03 Chinese-spirit fixed structures and national/era-spirit cores
C04 three-layer twelve-term core-values structure and role identities
C05 morality origin/nature/function layer, socialist morality core/principle, public morality and volunteer-service hats
C06 law nature/operation, rule-of-law hierarchy, Constitution, legal thinking and rights-obligations relation

admitted_deltas.delta: Life-value evaluation is anchored to whether practice conforms to the objective laws of social development and promotes historical progress, strengthening the learner boundary against subjective-success-only evaluation.
Current patriotism boundary: uphold a high degree of unity among loving the country, the Party and socialism.
Observing discipline and law is both a basic behavior rule for all citizens and the lowest requirement of social morality, preventing the false split between legal and public-morality identity.

Reinforce the role identities of building the socialist rule-of-law system, fair justice and law observance: rule-of-law system as structural grasp, fair justice as a high-value judicial/justice boundary, and law observance as the social foundation.

reviewed_no_additional_delta: C01 荣辱观 support beyond the already-restored dialectical life-conflict structure
C04 自由/平等/公正/法治 support beyond the exact Chengfeng three-layer twelve-term structure

acceptance_boundary: Content closure means the approved learning semantics contain every high-value identity/relation/boundary needed for the current first-round path. It does not mean every Chengfeng sentence, example, classification or low-risk list is duplicated into KianOS.
